SourceIndex.productMaterialization: Exact BASE originals only; overlay unchanged admitted test-role bodies, as prior baseline-red.

excludedCoverage: Other18 known cases are declared outside scope, natively filtered; never invented as missing/fail/pass. No mutant/green/regression/Task1 qualification.

reporter.input: Actual Node TestsStream test:pass/test:fail; original thrown error from data.details.error.cause per exact-version primary docs. No raw TAP parsing.
reporter.nativeCasesOnly: IDs only if native test name exactly matches selected2; unknown/file/hook native events have id:null and are auxiliaryEvents, never Source cases.

position.source: Only actual error stack frame or native test definition matched to exact13 admitted relative paths under fixed materialization root. Never raw stack/file path. Unmatched is null.

siteMap.meaning: Static classification from actual whitelisted error position, not guessed completion/progress.

reporter.values: Actual/expected only booleans; HTTP integers100..599 only for an actual assertion whose expected is200 or302. Other actual/expected (strings/objects/cookies/tokens/etc) never inspected for output.
reporter.stdoutPolicy: All Source stdout/stderr/diagnostic messages suppressed. Only exact typed custody preload record forwarded from test:stdout. No data.message output, raw Error.message, assertion text, stack/body/header/JWT/nonce/private field.

custody.childFlow: sudo -n env -i <explicit allowlist> unshare --net; root enables ONLY loopback; exec setpriv --reuid capturedParentUID --regid capturedParentGID --clear-groups --no-new-privs node. No sudo -E or user/group/sudoers/production permission mutation.
custody.parent: Actual parent uid>0/gid>=0 captured before first await; fail closed for root parent. No arbitrary UID input.
custody.guard: Loaded before test framework in each actual Node process. Compare getuid/getgid to exact captured parent; getgroups may include primary gid as Node guarantees, but no other supplementary group; networkInterfaces onlylo/internal127.0.0.1. Write owned per-process probe only inside verified task temp.
custody.publicFields: Only booleans and count. No raw uid/gid/pid/path.
custody.preflight: Same isolated/dropped-privilege child writes fixed owned probe. Outer verifies uid/gid+content then actually removes only own preflight area and verifies absence BEFORE Source diagnostic.
custody.final: Inspect bounded own custody probes, then remove only own verified task temp and verify absence. Actual cleanup success is required for diagnosticCaptureValid. Failure publishes only enum errno, no chmod/chown/bypass.
custody.hypothesisLimit: Previous cleanup cause is unknown; root-owned caches are a source-based hypothesis. New successful own-area cleanup cannot retroactively prove that cause or global native drain.
custody.guardThreadBehavior: Node22.23.4 --import is inherited by worker threads. Guard checks UID/GID/network on every import, but writes/emits per-process proof only on isMainThread, avoiding duplicate same-PID wx probes from worker threads.

summary.capture: Actual native status/signal/allowed spawn-error enum; complete flag; raw captured Buffer bytes/hash only. Data retained even if after-hook/open-handle timeout. No raw stdout/stderr.
summary.custodyPreflightCapture: Same bounded native metadata, separately captured even when preflight fails.
summary.casePolicy: Only actual selected Node events go into cases, no synthetic missing outcomes. Preserve observed2 even if child timeout; auxiliary file/hook events stay separate. Exact order checked only to validate capture.
summary.validMeaning: Schema/protocol+actual2 events+UID/GID/network/owned-preflight/final-cleanup validated. This is diagnostic data validity, NEVER Source qualification or Task1 PASS. Valid diagnostic can have failed OAuth or child timeout; SourceQualified andTask1Pass alwaysfalse.
summary.returnCode: 0 only for valid bounded diagnostic capture with observed2 actual cases and custody/cleanup verified, irrespective of casepass/fail; otherwise1. WorkflowSUCCESS is diagnostic collection only.
